items.title: How server utilization inflates latency
items.description: StreamCast's request plan costs 40ms nominal (at rest) against a 50ms SLA. Drag utilization up toward 100% and watch the same plan's real-world latency balloon — this is the ρ/(1−ρ) queueing multiplier from L3, applied to the plan's total. At the fleet's actual 92% utilization during the event, this reproduces the exact 500ms figure from the postmortem; drop it to the 70% target from computeThroughputBudget's 11-server fix and it falls to roughly 130ms.
items.compute: const rho = Math.min(Math.max(params.utilization, 0), 99) / 100; const queueingMultiplier = 1 + rho / (1 - rho); const estimatedMs = params.nominalPlanMs * queueingMultiplier; return { estimatedMs };
